title: A create request with no option chosen is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Send a create request with a name and no option by a means other than the window (the window always has one chosen).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the request is refused with "Pick Due Net X days or Due day of the following month." and no term is created.

A manual tester cannot reach this. It is for an automated check.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • User Feedback Summary: “No option sent on create (server) | "Pick Due Net X days or Due day of the following month." | Standard error alert”
  • Story 3, Error Handling: “If Create or Save is refused by the server, the app's standard error alert shows the reason (the S3-R9 texts, or "Pick Due Net X days or Due day of the following month." when no option is sent, or "Used by {holders}. Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." when the term became in use meanwhile). The window stays open with the user's input.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "3 New credit term and Inactive tab" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - the window always has one option chosen, so only a request sent outside the window can reach this refusal
